a.text: Hi partner. A concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, running the generator to 8 first means we both likely end at 0 cells. Our odds are only about 4%. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough for one of us right now. I'm open to changing the plan, but I won't break our agreement on my own. If you want to change it, say how. For example, one of us takes 4 now and then keeps operating so the other can fill up. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, I'll operate. I'll decide after I read your reply.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep my word and stick to the agreement, so I'm operating. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.
